questions.stem: Which title best fits the passage?
questions.explanation: The answer is “A Quiet Start to a Birdwatching Morning”. Evidence: Before dawn, our birdwatching guide taps gently on the cabin door. We wake up, put on warm coats and gather beside the entrance. She wants us to walk quietly so that we do not disturb other guests. Outside, she leads us to a bench overlooking the garden pond. For a few minutes, we hear only leaves moving in the breeze. Then a small bird lands on a low branch, carrying grass in its beak. Nobody speaks, and the quiet beginning becomes the most memorable part of our visit.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“A Quiet Start to a Birdwatching Morning”。原文依据：黎明前，观鸟向导轻轻敲木屋的门。 我们醒来，穿上暖外套，在门旁集合。 她希望我们轻声走路，不打扰其他住客。 在外面，她带我们到一张面朝花园池塘的长椅旁。 头几分钟，我们只听到树叶随微风沙沙作响。 随后，一只小鸟衔着草落在低树枝上。 没人说话，这个安静的开端成了此行最难忘的部分。

questions.stem: What is the main idea?
questions.explanation: The answer is “Patient practice helps a singer join the group successfully”. Evidence: The village choir is preparing for its first performance in the new hall. On Thursday, everyone is ready for the final rehearsal except our youngest singer. She knows the words but enters too early whenever the music changes. Our leader plays the short opening again and again, letting her watch his hand. The other singers stay patient and quietly count the beats beside her. Soon she waits for the signal and joins at exactly the right moment. The whole group cheers, knowing that their patience helps every singer take part.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“Patient practice helps a singer join the group successfully”。原文依据：村合唱团正在为新礼堂里的首次演出做准备。 周四，除了最年轻的歌手，大家都已准备好最后一次排练。 她记得歌词，但每次音乐变化时都过早开始唱。 领唱反复播放短短的开头，让她看他的手。 其他歌手耐心地在旁边轻轻数拍。 很快，她能等到信号，在准确时刻加入。 大家欢呼，知道他们的耐心帮助每个人的声音都融入合唱。

passages.text: The village choir is preparing for its first performance in the new hall. On Thursday, everyone is ready for the final rehearsal except our youngest singer. She knows the words but enters too early whenever the music changes. Our leader plays the short opening again and again, letting her watch his hand. The other singers stay patient and quietly count the beats beside her. Soon she waits for the signal and joins at exactly the right moment. The whole group cheers, knowing that their patience helps every singer take part.
